title: Ancient copper coins and a copper jar recovered in Kapilvastu
description: Kathmandu, July 22: A copper karuwa (a traditional water vessel) containing medieval coins have been discovered at Babhani in Kapilvastu Municipality–5. The artifact was found by local farmer Rajaram Yadav while he was working in his field. title: Kosovo: A young European society, ancient heritage, a new opening
description: In the heart of the Balkans lies Kosovo, a territory whose story is often told through the language of international politics, recognition, sovereignty and unresolved disputes. Yet behind those familiar diplomatic questions is a society of deep cultural memory, youthful ambition, religious diversity, historical resilience and a strong desire to be understood beyond the headlines. title: Luxmuralis illuminations return to the Old Royal Naval College to explore ancient civilisations with Lost Worlds
description: Luxmuralis returns to illuminate the Old Royal Naval College with Lost Worlds, a spectacular new light and sound installation inspired by the civilisations, myths and natural wonders of the ancient world. Created by acclaimed sculptor and artist Peter Walker, with an original score by composer David Harper, Lost Worlds reimagines the artistic achievements of the Etruscans, Egyptians, Romans, Mayans and Anglo-Saxons through immersive projection, colour and sound. Art has shaped the history of the Old Royal Naval College for centuries. Three hundred years after Sir James Thornhill completed the magnificent iconography of the Painted Hall in 1726, Walker draws upon the same enduring spirit of artistic innovation. His work transforms Sir Christopher Wren’s magnificent dome into a spectacular canvas of light by reimagining the iconic Painted Hall masterpiece in a series of bespoke projections.
